text:
sam: Heads-up: after this morning's firewall tighten in eu2, a bunch of staging GPU nodes (~40) are stuck in JOIN_PENDING. Keystore decrypts to KMS are timing out and we see NAT conntrack saturation + a huge spike in auditlog traffic. Rolling GPUs back to warm pool is painful. Anyone else seeing this?
oncall-bot: [ALERT] keystore-decrypt-timeouts eu2-warmpool (severity: high) - 2026-03-23T09:12:03Z
li: seeing same. quick summary from logs: many TLS handshakes to priv-keystore are retransmitting, KMS Decrypt latency 5-12s, then 504s. conntrack table is ~98% on natgw-a.
li: quick mitigation idea: temporary allowlist the priv-keystore subnet on the new FW rule so keystore traffic doesn't hit stateful inspection. patch diff I tested in staging:```- deny tcp 10.0.0.0/8 -> 172.31.20.0/24:443
+ allow tcp 10.0.0.0/8 -> 172.31.20.0/24:443 comment "keystore-allowlist-temp"```
anika: we can't just roll back the policy entirely (compliance asked for default deny), but allowlisting a specific keystore client subnet + scaling natgw conntrack is OK. also suggest enabling prefix-based cache bypass for onboarding requests to reduce KMS QPS.
diego: can we move the staging GPU joins to usw3-region warm pool while we triage? would reduce user impact and buy time. Paul, what’s cross-region data cost for moving ephemeral staging jobs?
paul: cross-region warmpool handshake + image pull will cost some egress, rough back-of-envelope: ~ $0.18/GB + ~0.50 for NATGW burst. If we shift ~40 nodes for an hour it's sub-$200. Cheaper than keeping GPUs idle in join pending for 3+ hours.
sam: @anika if we do an allowlist, can you add an IAM condition so only the provisioning role can talk to that subnet? compliance flagged open allowlists last quarter.
anika: yup — use an IAM condition tied to source-vpc and role arn:aws:iam::redwood:role/provisioner. We'll also add keystore audit tag so we can revoke fast.
li: applying temporary allowlist on eu2-fw now, scaling NATGW conntrack to 1.5x, and turned on conntrack-forwarding debug for 15m. Testing node join...
li: update ~ +2m: first node succeeded JOIN, KMS latency down to 200-400ms for decrypts, conntrack at 68%.
sam: nice. can we keep the allowlist for max 2 hours and then switch to a scoped ACL that limits by role + port? Also record the runbook steps.
anika: will draft scoped ACL + IAM condition and open a short-lived exception ticket (sec-exception-4321). I’ll post the playbook snippet to the runbook later.
diego: I'll start moving non-critical staging jobs to usw3 warmpool now. tagging nodes as "staging-migrate".
paul: logging cost spike noted in Billing — I flagged to finance, but agree temporary egress is cheaper.
sam: thanks everyone. once we have playbook I want a postmortem doc with numbers: joins delayed, KMS QPS, conntrack peaks, cost impact. cc @oncall-bot make sure this is captured in the incident timeline.
oncall-bot: Incident logged: INC-20260323-19 - eu2 keystore/backpressure impacting GPU onboarding. Assigned to sam, li, anika.
li: leaving a short command snippet I used to scale conntrack on natgw (linux host):```sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144
sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_established=432000```
anika: noted. will follow up with scoped ACL PR and IAM condition within 45m.
sam: ack. ping me when PR is merged and we'll close the exception window. :thumbsup:
